title: observability: add token-level KV/cache metrics, Grafana dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Marina Chen
release_notes: Add token-level KV/cache metrics, new Grafana dashboards for cost/latency breakdown, and tuned alerts to reduce noise while catching regressions.
description: Context: We need better signal for token-level cost and latency regressions that originate from KV cache degradation and scheduling anomalies. This PR adds Prometheus metrics and distributed tracing spans for per-request token accounting, surfaces those metrics in Grafana dashboards wired into the Console, and updates alerting thresholds to reduce false positives while keeping guardrails for regressions. Motivation: several customer incidents (linked SUP-1371) showed increased per-token latency due to suboptimal cache hit ratios and unexpected model fallbacks. Goals: (1) expose token-level cost/latency breakdowns (compute, kv-lookup, scheduling, network), (2) add KV cache hit/miss histograms and per-model prefix cache stats, (3) add tracing spans for KV lookup and scheduling paths, (4) ship Grafana dashboards and test alert tuning to avoid alert storms. Changes: - instrumentation: add metrics: redwood_inference_tokens_total, redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_lookup_latency_seconds_summary, redwood_model_fallbacks_total. Each metric has labels: model, region, route, kv_shard, backend_tier. - tracing: add spans 'kv_lookup' and 'scheduling_enqueue' with attributes token_count and cache_hit boolean propagated via TraceContext. - dashboards: new grafana JSONs added under observability/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.json and linked in Console config. Dashboards include: token-level cost/latency waterfall, KV cache heatmap by prefix, per-model prefix hit-rate, and time-to-first-token distribution. - alerts: tuned existing alerting rules: lower sensitivity for transient increases by applying 5m->15m rolling windows and adding minimum-token-count filters; add a new alert 'HighKVMissRate' scoped to kv_shard and model with medium severity. - tests and CI: unit tests for metrics labels and tracing propagation; small e2e in perf-canary to validate dashboard panels render and alert triggers in the test environment. Checklist: - [x] Metrics added and unit-tested - [x] Tracing spans added and end-to-end propagation verified - [x] Grafana dashboards created and linked to Console - [x] Alerts tuned and smoke-tested in staging - [x] Docs: Console docs snippet added for the new dashboard locations Implementation notes: - Metrics use existing prometheus client and follow our metric naming conventions (redwood_*). - To avoid cardinality explosion we limit prefix label to first 4 chars and only expose kv_shard for internal shards. - Alert tuning: alerts only fire when request_token_count > 50 to reduce noisy signals from short requests. Related: ENG-4821 (dashboard work), ENG-4912 (kv cache instrumentation), SUP-1371 (customer incident).
